Special looks & odds

Shiny, Void, Prismatic, Gilded, Mirage, Perfect, Alpha, Lucky: odds everywhere and what each one does.

Wild oddsGildedMirageHow combos lookSpooky season: SpectralBoostsOther sources

Each look rolls on its own, so combos happen (Shiny Void, Void Prismatic, Gilded Shiny… up to Shiny Void Prismatic). Void is 3× rarer than Shiny, Prismatic 8× rarer, and Gilded 2× rarer than Prismatic from the same source.

Shiny ★+10% all stats, and +15% money from every battle while it's in your party (up to 3 shinies). Catch: ×1.Void ◆Dark violet crystal. Stats ×1.2, extra HP (+0.4 × level), and its shell halves the first hit it takes each fight. Catch ×0.6.Prismatic ✦Rainbow crystal. Stats ×1.3 (×1.4 if also Void), extra HP (+0.6 × level), and the whole party gets +10% all stats while it's with you. Catch ×0.4.Gilded ❖Solid gold. Looks only: no stat, battle, Luck or raid effect. Found in Raid Eggs and on Battle Tower wild floors, or bred from a Gilded parent; never in the wild. 2× rarer than Prismatic from the same source. Always gets a Master Ball and never runs. Stacks with every look.MirageSunset colours that waver like a heat haze. Found only in the Safari Zone, or bred from a Mirage parent; it stays Mirage forever. In battle: Rising Heat, +5% Speed each turn on the field, up to +25% (not in raids). Stacks with every look.Spectral 👻Spooky season only (October 26 to November 9, 2026; the season is over for this year): a see-through ghost of itself, pale teal and glowing. It stacks with every other look (a Spectral Shiny is a golden ghost) and stays Spectral forever. 1.25× rarer than Prismatic, from every source.Perfect IVs ♛All six IVs at 31, plus +10% all stats (Flawless).AlphaA boss that joined you: drawn bigger, +20% all stats. Passes on in eggs.Lucky10% of traded Pokémon arrive Lucky: its IVs are rerolled to 28–31 each (nature, ability and gender stay).

Wild odds

Your wild Shiny odds = your rank's base ÷ (1 + 0.12 × Shiny Charm level). Void = Shiny × 3, Prismatic = Shiny × 8. Perfect IVs use the rank's own odds (the charm doesn't change them).

A calculator runs in the live wiki. Open this page in the live wiki to use it.

Gilded

  • Raid Eggs: 1 in 600 per egg (Prismatic's 1 in 300 × 2), rolled on its own like every look.
  • Battle Tower wild floors: 1 in 12,000 at Luck 0 on a Route, made likelier by Luck and Dens exactly like Prismatic (Prismatic 1 in 6,000).
  • Day Care eggs: only with a Gilded parent. Worked out like Prismatic with the Gilded parents instead, then 2× rarer.
  • "Crystal" odds events from the Tallgrass team boost Gilded like Prismatic.
  • Gilded trades at trade level 4 and can be sold on the Night Market and in Auctions. It has its own page in the Stamp book.

Mirage

  • Safari Zone: 1 in (your wild Shiny odds × 10) per encounter, ×2 in Golden Hour, ×1.25 in the Ranger Outfit. Never on the islands, in raids or in the Tower.
  • Day Care eggs: only from a Mirage parent, at the same Safari rarity (see Day Care).
  • Rising Heat: +5% Speed for each turn it stays on the field, up to +25%. Every battle except raids.
  • Trades at trade level 4, like Void and Prismatic.

How combos look

  • Void + Prismatic: an obsidian body with a flowing rainbow edge and glow.
  • Shiny + Void: the violet Void body with a gold edge and a pulsing gold glow.
  • Shiny + Prismatic: pearl white with drifting pastel colours.
  • Shiny + Void + Prismatic: the Void body, a rainbow edge and a gold glow.
  • Gilded + Shiny: platinum (white gold with an icy shine); with Void it also gets a violet edge and glow.
  • Mirage + Gilded: a gold statue shimmering in the heat haze.

Spooky season: Spectral

Spooky season ran October 26 to November 9, 2026 and is over for this year; Spectral Pokémon caught then stay Spectral forever. While it was open, Spectral Pokémon haunted the routes. Spectral is always a little rarer than Prismatic: Prismatic odds × 1.25 wherever you find it, wild (with your rank, Shiny Charm and radar chain), Day Care eggs (each Spectral parent helps), Raid Eggs, Gift and Costume Eggs, prize encounters, starters and the Tower. Odds events boost it like the other looks. At the top rank with a max Shiny Charm that's 1 in 3,000 per wild Pokémon.

Find them fast: the Spectral filter in the PC, the search words "spectral" or "spooky", and the Spectral view in the Pokédex. The Events tab shows the season band with your own odds and the days left. A Spectral adds 50 Glimmer to what it is worth on the Night Market.

Special finds are protected by default: never knocked out, never sent to the Professor, and each one stamps your Stamp book. Evolving a special waits for you (press Evolve in the PC).
